sections.kicker: Prepared for Kind Sir by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a company buying gifts would. Here is what stood out.
sections.thesis: Kind Sir has a sharp offer on Instagram and an empty front door on the site.
sections.keep: The stamped tags in your hero shot. The words on the leather show care before anyone reads a line.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The site opens with a logo and two words.
pins.why: A corporate buyer cannot tell from the first screen that you make custom pieces or that they are made in Australia.
pins.how: Say what Kind Sir makes and for whom in one line on the hero.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: Gift buyers compare you on price because the site gives them nothing else.

pins.quote: Custom LEATHER GOODS worth keeping Made in Australia with human hands
pins.what: Instagram has the line the site is missing.
pins.why: Worth keeping and made by human hands is the reason to pay more than a promo supplier.
pins.how: Move this line to the site, word for word.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The reason to choose you lives in a bio most buyers never open.

pins.what: The profile name pulls two ways.
pins.why: Custom leather goods and corporate gifting are two different buyers, and the name asks both to fit.
pins.how: Choose the lead buyer, and let the other become a line inside it.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Each buyer sees a brand that is half for someone else.

sections.intro: You said your messaging is not clear. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Here is where it gets lost.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Kind Sir's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
